Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 8-frame WALK CYCLE sprite atlas, one character and ONE fixed direction.
Input image 1: identity, clothes and rendering-style reference.
Subject: the same compact halfling rogue girl Trinity from the reference: short curly black hair, freckles, cream fur collar, brown leather shoulder armor and bracers, dark sleeves, cream split tunic, brown belts/pouches, dark leggings and cream leather boots. Keep her exact face, hair, outfit, colors, short sturdy proportions and fine painted ink-outline fantasy sprite style. Unarmed walking, do not invent weapons or accessories.
View/direction: exact REAR view, walking straight AWAY from the viewer toward the TOP of the screen. Show the back of the head and body, NO visible face. Planted feet show their heels from behind, not front-facing toes. Maintain this exact camera/view and heading in EVERY frame; do NOT make a turntable.
Composition: exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, eight chronological frames read left-to-right row 1 then row 2. Full body, same scale and proportions each frame, walking IN PLACE without horizontal translation. Fixed gentle elevated RPG camera (about 20 degrees above horizontal), natural moderate stride, not exaggerated running.
Gait phases: 1 left foot forward contact, both feet on ground; 2 left foot takes weight, right heel lifts; 3 right foot passes the planted left leg; 4 right foot swings forward; 5 right foot forward contact, both feet on ground; 6 right foot takes weight, left heel lifts; 7 left foot passes planted right leg; 8 left foot swings forward, transitioning seamlessly back to frame 1. Clearly alternate LEFT and RIGHT legs. Subtle opposite arm swing and cloth/hair motion. No duplicate frozen poses.
CRITICAL ANATOMY: two normal legs and two matching boots only. Knees bend forward anatomically, toes point in the direction of walking, heels backward. No reversed feet, twisted ankles, bent-back knees, foot swapping, disconnected limbs or extra shoes.
GRID SAFETY: each sprite including hair, arms and book fits fully inside its own cell. Figure occupies at most 65% of cell width and about 65% of cell height. At least 15% clear transparent padding on EVERY side of EVERY cell. Center pelvis consistently at the same horizontal location in each cell; align ground-contact feet to the same relative baseline. No silhouettes crossing cell borders or touching neighboring sprites.
Genuinely transparent RGBA background. NO floor, shadow, ground oval, scenery, grid lines, labels, numbers, letters, text or watermark. Preserve the reference character, no redesign, no inconsistent clothes or giant feet.
